We’re gathering for worship, and we want you right there with us.  
First Saturday of each month, 12 PM, 24301 Telegraph, Southfield MI—come experience the presence together.  
And every weekday, 8:15 AM, join the Hour of Power on Facebook Live for a fresh word to start your day.  

The invitation stands: step into the house, log in online, and let God move.  

Who’s joining us today? Tag a friend who needs this.
